description: This file defines the Smarty_Internal_Method_SetDebugTemplate class, which implements a method to set a debug template in the Smarty templating system. It includes a single method setDebugTemplate that handles assigning a debug template file to a Smarty object.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_SetDebugTemplate
classes.description: A class providing an implementation of the setDebugTemplate method for Smarty, allowing the configuration of a debug template.

methods.name: setDebugTemplate
methods.description: Sets the debug template for a Smarty object, validating readability of the file and assigning it to the object's debug_tpl property.
